episode_summary_beat: Lady Juliana is cruelly abandoned at the altar by her fiancé Gerald, who marries her sister Clarissa instead while her family looks on with cold disdain.

candidates.hook: Juliana is stopped midway down the aisle by her family and told her groom is marrying someone else.
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana turns to her own father for help, only to have him cruelly ignore her and stare at the floor.
candidates.why_it_works_draft: Delivers the ultimate emotional betrayal and humiliation instantly, hooking viewers who hate seeing innocent characters trampled.

notable_stitch_beats.summary: Gerald coldly rejects Juliana for her lack of value, leading to her silent, steely glare of defiance as the screen cuts to black.

episode_summary_beat: Abandoned at the altar by Gerald for her cruel sister Clarissa, Juliana fights back tears to deliver a devastating public indictment of his honor.

candidates.hook: Gerald callously abandons Juliana at the altar in front of the entire aristocratic congregation.
candidates.cliffhanger: Clarissa mocks Juliana as a kitchen maid who wandered into the wrong wedding.
candidates.why_it_works_draft: Instantly triggers outrage from the viewer against the arrogant groom and cruel sister, setting up an explosive revenge arc.

candidates.hook: Juliana's tearful expression transforms into a steely, defiant smile.
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana declares she leaves the chapel with her head held high while Gerald stands stunned and speechless.
candidates.why_it_works_draft: Delivers an immensely satisfying emotional reversal where the humiliated heroine seizes total control of the room with an empowering speech.

notable_stitch_beats.summary: Gerald coldly tells Juliana he cannot marry her because she is far too plain.
Juliana turns her heartbreak into a fierce public dressing down of Gerald's worthless word.

episode_summary_beat: Banished and abused by her aristocratic family at the altar, Juliana is rescued by a mysterious scarred warrior who drops to one knee with a stunning proposal.

candidates.hook: The Noble Matriarch orders guards to seize and drag away the abandoned Juliana.
candidates.cliffhanger: The mysterious scarred stranger kneels before Juliana and asks for her hand in marriage.
candidates.why_it_works_draft: Pure emotional whiplash from family cruelty to a dramatic rescue and romantic proposal that satisfies every microdrama craving.

notable_stitch_beats.summary: Guards brutally seize and drag Juliana out of the chapel on her family's orders.
The mysterious scarred warrior drops to one knee and proposes to stunned high society.

episode_summary_beat: Scorned by her faithless ex-fiancé and cruel family, Juliana defies her abusers by marrying the mysterious scarred warrior and walking out into the light together.

candidates.hook: The priest pronounces Juliana and the scarred warrior husband and wife as dramatic music swells.
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana and her new husband walk hand-in-hand through the massive oak doors into the bright sunlight, turning their backs on her disowning family.
candidates.why_it_works_draft: Delivers ultimate emotional payoff, public humiliation of toxic exes, and a triumphant walkout into freedom.
candidates.spoiler_reason: Shows Juliana being formally disowned and married to the stranger.

notable_stitch_beats.summary: Gerald flies into a furious rage after the wedding pronouncement, and Juliana delivers a cold, cutting comeback.

episode_summary_beat: Disowned and humiliated by her callous family after her wedding, Juliana has her mother's heirloom ledger thrown into the mud, but her fierce new husband defends her dignity and leads her away.

candidates.hook: Lady Ashcroft violently rips Juliana's treasured mother's ledger out of her hands and flings it into the mud.
candidates.cliffhanger: The mysterious scarred husband gives Gerald a lethal, chilling warning before walking away with Juliana.
candidates.why_it_works_draft: Combines raw public humiliation and betrayal by family with an instant badass protective power move by the new husband.
candidates.spoiler_reason: Shows Juliana being formally disowned and stripped of her inheritance.

notable_stitch_beats.summary: Step-mother violently throws the mother's heirloom ledger into the mud.
The scarred husband delivers a lethally cold warning to the arrogant former fiancé.
